facts.fact: AMI reports phase 1 of the border-zone electronic communication coverage project, launched in December 2023 across 42 solar sites, benefited over 85,000 citizens.
facts.system: Projet de couverture integrale des services de communication electronique dans les zones frontalieres

facts.fact: AMI reports President Ghazouani laid the foundation stone on 28 December 2024 for phases 2 and 3 of the project, covering 964 km, 100 sites and 21 transport sites in the southern and south-eastern border zones.
